items.title: Tether holds 150,000 bitcoin worth $11.5 billion, CEO Paolo Ardoino says
items.summary: Ardoino didn’t say where the extra coins sit. Holdings outside USDT reserves, such as Tether’s investments, wouldn’t appear in the report.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
items.summary: A fifth straight weekly decline would mark bitcoin’s joint third-longest losing streak, as oil rebounds and Apple’s margin warning adds to investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterms.

items.title: North Korea denies role in $6.4 billion Binance hack after FBI points to TraderTraitor
items.summary: The high-profile denial follows FBI alerts identifying North Korean-controlled wallet addresses tied to the largest cryptocurrency exploit in history.

items.title: Mercado Bitcoin pledges to cover all user losses after near $40 million hack
items.summary: Partners like Tether, Circle, and Chainalysis helped freeze $11M of the stolen assets.

items.title: Bitcoin’s latest chart signal looks a lot like the ones before its big crashes
items.summary: The Guppy Multiple Moving Average bands signal a bearish momentum, even as seasonality and post-midterm history lean bullish.

items.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
items.summary: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.

items.title: Bitcoin miner Cipher posts $31 million profit as AI pivot begins
items.summary: The company's revenue dropped 63% in the third quarter, while a $127 million accounting gain helped turn an operating loss into a reported profit.

items.title: Arbitrum’s council moved $30 million of Binance hack funds without the hacker’s key
items.summary: A 12-person committee briefly rewrote one of Arbitrum’s core contracts to spend from an address it held no key for, then put the code back. It’s the second time this year.

items.title: Bitcoin drops below $77,000 as chip rout deepens ahead of U.S. midterm vote
items.summary: ZEC tumbled nearly 10% and BNB fell under $700 as the Nasdaq 100 slid into a correction, dragging Asian stocks lower.

items.title: Big crypto wants the one thing it can’t buy: your vote
items.summary: Our loyalty has been to the technology. This election, the trap is to let the biggest intermediaries claim it for themselves, argues Berkeley Law lecturer Hermine Wong.

items.title: France postpones 2027 budget vote, crypto exit-tax proposals scrapped
items.summary: The National Assembly postponed the vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time, while the Nov. 17 deadline for the first reading examination nears.

items.title: Bitcoin price threatens $77.7K support loss with recent buyers underwater
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below the realized price of the one-to-three-month-old buyer cohort in a move that risked flipping it to new resistance.

items.title: ARK buys $17M in Coinbase, Circle shares while trimming Bullish
items.summary: ARK Invest added Coinbase and Circle shares across two trading sessions while selling about $8 million in Bullish as crypto stocks declined.

items.title: Suspected EU crypto theft estimate rises to $133M: ZachXBT
items.summary: ZachXBT identified another $27 million in exchange withdrawals, some of which occurred after he first flagged the suspected crypto theft.

items.title: BlackRock’s IBIT sees biggest Bitcoin ETF outflows since June
items.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF shed $405.3 million on Monday as US spot Bitcoin funds opened November with nearly $399 million in net outflows.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Crypto.com to withdraw Hong Kong consumer app citing regulatory changes
items.summary: Crypto.com will discontinue its consumer app services in Hong Kong in February next year.

items.title: Australia lifts rates to 18-year high as AI boom, energy costs fuel inflation
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark rate to 4.85% on rising technology costs from AI investment and higher energy prices.

items.title: UK warns AI ransomware attack on infrastructure ‘highly likely’ by 2028
items.summary: The warning comes as UK cyber officials also flag growing threats from state-backed hackers targeting government officials and politicians.

items.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
items.summary: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Sunday.

items.title: North Korea Denies $6.3B Binance Hack, Calls FBI Finding a 'Political Provocation'
items.summary: Kim Yo Jong suggested the U.S. itself could be behind the theft, as Binance said hourly deposits had begun to exceed withdrawals.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.5, GPT 6.2 Astra Could Be Right Around the Corner, Leaks Suggest
items.summary: Users say Claude is routing some requests to a stronger unreleased model, a Mythos 5.5 label appeared in Anthropic’s site code, and OpenAI appears to be testing GPT-6.2 Astra.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
items.summary: Strive added 124 Bitcoin for about $10 million and now trails Twenty One Capital by 390 BTC for third place among Treasury companies.

items.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
items.summary: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

items.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
items.summary: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.

items.title: Tom Lee Calls Bottom on AI Stock Selloff, Citing Tight Supply and Crypto Resilience
items.summary: The Fundstrat strategist says constraints on AI spending have slowed growth without ending the boom, while crypto’s response to the Binance hack suggests sellers may already be exhausted.

items.title: North Korea Is Laundering Binance Hack Loot at One New Wallet Every 25 Seconds
items.summary: $2.85 billion of the $6.43 billion stolen from Binance has been frozen or seized, compared with about 3% in the Bybit hack, as North Korea’s automated laundering spans 12,000 wallets.

items.title: Proton Users Revolt After CEO Calls Security Caution 'Loser Thinking' Amid AI Push
items.summary: Proton customers say they are canceling subscriptions after reports of pressure to adopt AI coding, as the privacy company scraps employee re-interviews but defends its broader shift toward automated development.

items.title: Nvidia and Nike Lead Biggest Wave Yet of Tokenized Stock Objections
items.summary: Nvidia, Costco, Nike and nine other companies objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 50.

items.title: Elon Musk Mocks Sam Altman Over Claim Home PCs Are Wasting RAM
items.summary: The OpenAI CEO said it's "quite terrible" for DRAM to sit largely idle in personal computers while AI data centers face a supply crunch.
